title: SpaceUsage
description: Space-level usage and cost for the current billing cycle.

storage_mib.description: Total storage used across all databases in the space, in MiB.

storage_limit_mib.description: Storage quota for the space, in MiB.

compute_minutes.description: Total compute minutes used across all databases in the space during the current billing cycle.

free_compute_minutes.description:
Compute minutes included per billing cycle at no additional charge,
shared across all standard databases in the space. Usage beyond this
is billed only when `overages_enabled` is true.

compute_limit_minutes.description:
Compute-minute quota for the space. When exceeded, all standard
databases in the space are automatically paused. `null` means no
limit — only possible when `overages_enabled` is true.

overages_enabled.description: Whether the space has compute overages enabled.

cost_to_date.description: Gross cost accrued so far this billing cycle.

estimated_total_cost.description: Projected gross total for the current billing cycle based on usage to date.

billing_period_start.description: Start of the current billing cycle.

billing_period_end.description: End of the current billing cycle.
